messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty -> PD-78921 triggered: High 5xx error rate detected on inference-gateway-us-east1 (error rate spike >= 300% baseline)

alice (oncall): I'm on it. Seeing a sudden spike in 500/502 responses across the gateway. Starting triage.

jordan (sre): @alice any impact to Dedicated pools or just Hosted API?

alice (oncall): Hosted API primarily, but Dedicated pools show a small uptick in 502s (~2%). Traffic is ~3x baseline. Token service latency looks normal.

manu (infra): CPU on gateway-proxy pods at ~95% and conn queue is growing. Could be keepalive/connection saturation rather than downstream compute. Rolling restart of subset might relieve.

alice (oncall): Scaling inference-gateway horizontally now: `kubectl -n prod scale deployment inference-gateway --replicas=12` -> issuing.

pagerduty-bot: PD-78921 acknowledged by alice (oncall) at 1768503225 :white_check_mark:

olivia (product): Heads-up: support slack shows EU customers reporting failed calls. Sending internal heads-up to CS.

jordan (sre): Adding temporary fallback routing to divert a small percent to us-west1: `routectl set-fallback inference-gw us-west1 --pct=10` (dry-run then apply).

alice (oncall): K8s scale returned: replicas 8 -> 12. Ephemeral drop in 5xx but still a sustained tail on larger payload requests.

manu (infra): Restarting 3 gateway pods in sequence to clear stuck fd/socket state:
```
for p in $(kubectl get pods -l app=inference-gateway -o name | head -n 3); do
  kubectl delete $p
  sleep 10
done
```

alice (oncall): Doing the sequential restarts now. Also pushing reduced nginx keepalive (60s -> 15s) to canary to avoid idle-socket exhaustion.

jordan (sre): I'm seeing a correlation: periodic telemetry job from 10.12.8.45 hammering a heavy endpoint with large payloads at 3x intended frequency. That amplifies backend latency. Can we throttle that agent at the edge?

olivia (product): Which tenants are affected? I can reach out. Initial list: acme-inc, beta-platform, and two smaller tenants — CS on it.

manu (infra): Pushed an iptables rate-limit for 10.12.8.45 at the edge (200r/s -> 10r/s) and added ACL to block bursts for now.

alice (oncall): After restarts + rate-limiting, 5xx rate dropped significantly. Monitoring 10m window for stabilization.

pagerduty-bot: PD-78921 escalated to oncall-sre (jordan) at 1768503350 :arrow_up:

jordan (sre): Jumping in. Logs show upstream redis/kv-cache timeouts spiking during the traffic surge — got a cascade: cache 504 -> gateway 502/500. Warming cache should help.

alice (oncall): Kicking cache warm job: `python tools/warm_cache.py --prefix=/prompts/highleads --concurrency=20` -> started.

olivia (product): I'm sending customer notification email using template "degraded inference responses" to the affected accounts now.

jordan (sre): Monitoring 5m window: token-level error budget trending back to safe; long-lived streaming requests still show occasional 502s. Suspect envoy filter added in EU canary earlier today affecting header size handling.

alice (oncall): Rolling back the envoy header-size filter in EU canary (deployed ~2h ago) as a precaution.

manu (infra): Envoy rollback applied. No immediate regression detected.

alice (oncall): Current metrics (last 15m): error rate ~0.7% (baseline 0.6%). Latency back to normal for most request shapes. We'll keep the thread open for 1 hour after stabilization. Assigning postmortem to @jordan.

jordan (sre): I'll own the postmortem. Root-cause hypothesis: combined effect of an overly-chatty third-party telemetry job + cache pressure causing redis timeouts -> upstream errors -> gateway saturation and connection exhaustion. Action items: 1) enforce telemetry rate-limits and IP-based burst controls, 2) add cache warming and better cache capacity alarms, 3) refine envoy filter testing to avoid header regressions, 4) improve runbook steps for conn-saturation.

olivia (product): Customer notifications dispatched; CS to follow up with top 3 impacted. No legal/regulatory escalations needed at this time.

pagerduty-bot: PD-78921 resolved by alice (oncall) at 1768503578 :tada:

alice (oncall): Closing thread — will attach postmortem link when ready. Thanks for the quick triage and help :heart:
